tasks.title: Lockdown public execute grants on maintenance and queue RPCs
tasks.commit_message: fix(db): lockdown maintenance and queue RPC execute grants (SEC-WIN-020)
tasks.notes: Revokes EXECUTE from PUBLIC/anon/authenticated on purge_old_app_logs(integer), expire_stale_standby_queue(integer, uuid), mask_old_notification_logs(integer), and enqueue_refund_request(uuid, uuid, text). Explicitly preserves EXECUTE on dispatch_booking_notification for authenticated users (with in-function auth) to prevent breaking bookings UI.

governance_items.title: Plaintext Storage of 4-Digit Check-In PIN at Rest
governance_items.rationale: Cleartext 4-digit PIN storage accepted with compensating controls: 5-failure/60s rate limit lockout, 60-minute pre-slot window, appointment date matching, strict customer RLS (customer_id = auth.uid()), zero merchant read grants, and fail-closed CheckoutModal verification.

governance_items.title: Inclusion of Demo/Mock Account Seed Credentials in Source Control
governance_items.rationale: supabase/seed.sql contains mock/demo account seed credentials strictly for local Docker development and E2E testing. Remote hosted deployments execute migrations only and skip db seed.

governance_items.title: Historical Exposure of Supabase JWT Credentials in Git Commit History
governance_items.rationale: Exposed keys in commits 9305ab5c, 34b7d2c7, and 5e515195 require secret rotation in the upstream Supabase dashboard for project ynkdnwhubfknnnzjtpeg, followed by git history rewrite via git-filter-repo. Documented in .gsd/MANUAL_ACTIONS.md.
